#### Stacked Area chat for Chemotherapy Patient 152 (pCR)

```{r}
# Filter data for Patient I52
patient_data <- chemo[, colData(chemo)$PatientID == "NT152"]
```

```{r}

# Get colData
col_data <- as.data.frame(colData(patient_data))

# Filter for Baseline and Post-treatment only
timepoint_data <- col_data %>%
  filter(BiopsyPhase %in% c("Baseline", "Post-treatment"))

# ---- NEW: exclude "Other"/"Othres"/"Others" BEFORE computing percentages ----
timepoint_data <- timepoint_data %>%
  filter(!tolower(ParentCelltypes) %in% c("other", "others", "othres"))

# Calculate cell type proportions for each timepoint (re-normalized to 100%)
cell_props <- timepoint_data %>%
  group_by(BiopsyPhase, ParentCelltypes) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(BiopsyPhase) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (count / sum(count)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Convert BiopsyPhase to numeric with intermediate points for smooth interpolation
cell_props_expanded <- cell_props %>%
  mutate(timepoint_num = ifelse(BiopsyPhase == "Baseline", 1, 3)) %>%
  arrange(ParentCelltypes, timepoint_num)

# Add intermediate interpolation points for smooth area transitions
cell_props_interpolated <- cell_props_expanded %>%
  group_by(ParentCelltypes) %>%
  complete(timepoint_num = seq(1, 3, by = 0.1)) %>%
  arrange(ParentCelltypes, timepoint_num) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = approx(
      x = timepoint_num[!is.na(percentage)],
      y = percentage[!is.na(percentage)],
      xout = timepoint_num
    )$y
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Define cell type colors (remove Other)
cell_type_colors <- c(
  "Cancer Cells" = "#0000FF",
  "Effector T Cells" = "#00FFFF",
  "Endothelial Cells" = "#4E1251",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#FF0000",
  "Macrophages" = "#00FF00",
  "Regulatory T Cells" = "#FD3DB5"
)
```

```{r}

# Create stacked area chart with smooth transitions
cell_type_colors_use <- cell_type_colors[names(cell_type_colors) %in% unique(cell_props_interpolated$ParentCelltypes)]


p1 <- ggplot(
  cell_props_interpolated,
  aes(x = timepoint_num, y = percentage, fill = ParentCelltypes, group = ParentCelltypes)
) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.85, color = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 3),
    labels = c("Baseline", "Post-treatment"),
    limits = c(1, 3),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_type_colors_use) +
  labs(
    title = "Patient 152",
    x = "",
    y = "% of Patient 152 cells ",
    fill = "Cell Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25))

print(p1)
```

```{r}


# Save as high-resolution PNG
ggsave(
  filename = "Patient_NT152_CellType_Composition.png",
  plot = p1,
  width = 6,        # Width in inches
  height = 4,        # Height in inches
  dpi = 1200,         # High resolution (300 DPI for publication quality)
  bg = "white"       # White background
)
```

#### Stacked Area chat for Chemotherapy Patient 248 (RD)


```{r}
# Get colData
# Get colData
col_data2 <- as.data.frame(colData(patient_data2))

# Filter for Baseline and Post-treatment only
timepoint_data2 <- col_data2 %>%
  filter(BiopsyPhase %in% c("Baseline", "Post-treatment"))

# ---- NEW: exclude "Other"/"Othres"/"Others" BEFORE computing percentages ----
timepoint_data2 <- timepoint_data2 %>%
  filter(!tolower(ParentCelltypes) %in% c("other", "others", "othres"))

# Calculate cell type proportions for each timepoint (re-normalized to 100%)
cell_props2 <- timepoint_data2 %>%
  group_by(BiopsyPhase, ParentCelltypes) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(BiopsyPhase) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (count / sum(count)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check the data before plotting
print("Cell types at each timepoint:")
print(cell_props2)

# Better approach - ensure clean interpolation
cell_props_expanded2 <- cell_props2 %>%
  # Add timepoint numbers
  mutate(timepoint_num = ifelse(BiopsyPhase == "Baseline", 1, 3)) %>%
  # Ensure all cell types exist at both timepoints
  complete(ParentCelltypes, 
           timepoint_num = c(1, 3),
           fill = list(count = 0, percentage = 0)) %>%
  # Fill in the BiopsyPhase for the added rows
  mutate(BiopsyPhase = ifelse(timepoint_num == 1, "Baseline", "Post-treatment")) %>%
  arrange(ParentCelltypes, timepoint_num)

# Check expanded data
print("Expanded data:")
print(cell_props_expanded2)


# Now interpolate with better handling
cell_props_interpolated2 <- cell_props_expanded2 %>%
  group_by(ParentCelltypes) %>%
  # Create all intermediate points
  reframe(
    timepoint_num = seq(1, 3, by = 0.1),
    percentage = approx(
      x = c(1, 3),
      y = percentage,
      xout = seq(1, 3, by = 0.1),
      method = "linear",
      rule = 2
    )$y
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # *** NEW: Re-normalize to ensure sum = 100 at each timepoint ***
  group_by(timepoint_num) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (percentage / sum(percentage)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check for any NA values
print("Any NAs in interpolated data:")
print(sum(is.na(cell_props_interpolated2$percentage)))
print("Sum at each timepoint (should all be 100):")
print(cell_props_interpolated2 %>% group_by(timepoint_num) %>% summarise(total = sum(percentage)))
```

#### Chemoimmune Patient 115 (pCr)

```{r}
# Filter data for Patient I15
patient_data3 <- chemo_imm[, colData(chemo_imm)$PatientID == "NT115"]
patient_data3
```

```{r}

# Get colData
col_data3 <- as.data.frame(colData(patient_data3))

# Filter for Baseline and Post-treatment only
timepoint_data3 <- col_data3 %>%
  filter(BiopsyPhase %in% c("Baseline", "Post-treatment"))

# Exclude "Other"/"Othres"/"Others" BEFORE computing percentages
timepoint_data3 <- timepoint_data3 %>%
  filter(!tolower(ParentCelltypes) %in% c("other", "others", "othres"))

# Calculate cell type proportions for each timepoint (re-normalized to 100%)
cell_props3 <- timepoint_data3 %>%
  group_by(BiopsyPhase, ParentCelltypes) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(BiopsyPhase) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (count / sum(count)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Ensure clean interpolation
cell_props_expanded3 <- cell_props3 %>%
  mutate(timepoint_num = ifelse(BiopsyPhase == "Baseline", 1, 3)) %>%
  complete(ParentCelltypes, 
           timepoint_num = c(1, 3),
           fill = list(count = 0, percentage = 0)) %>%
  mutate(BiopsyPhase = ifelse(timepoint_num == 1, "Baseline", "Post-treatment")) %>%
  arrange(ParentCelltypes, timepoint_num)

# Interpolate
cell_props_interpolated3 <- cell_props_expanded3 %>%
  group_by(ParentCelltypes) %>%
  reframe(
    timepoint_num = seq(1, 3, by = 0.1),
    percentage = approx(
      x = c(1, 3),
      y = percentage,
      xout = seq(1, 3, by = 0.1),
      method = "linear",
      rule = 2
    )$y
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(percentage = ifelse(is.na(percentage) | is.nan(percentage), 0, percentage)) %>%
  group_by(timepoint_num) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (percentage / sum(percentage)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(percentage = ifelse(is.na(percentage) | is.nan(percentage), 0, percentage))

# NEW APPROACH: Manually calculate ymin and ymax for each cell type
# Define stacking order (bottom to top)
stack_order <- c("Macrophages", "Fibroblasts", "Regulatory T Cells", 
                 "Endothelial Cells", "Effector T Cells", "Cancer Cells")

cell_props_interpolated3 <- cell_props_interpolated3 %>%
  mutate(ParentCelltypes = factor(ParentCelltypes, levels = stack_order)) %>%
  arrange(timepoint_num, ParentCelltypes) %>%
  group_by(timepoint_num) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(percentage),
    ymin = ymax - percentage
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}



# Filter data for Patient 017
patient_data4 <- chemo_imm[, colData(chemo_imm)$PatientID == "NT017"]

# Get colData
col_data4 <- as.data.frame(colData(patient_data4))

# Filter for Baseline and Post-treatment only
timepoint_data4 <- col_data4 %>%
  filter(BiopsyPhase %in% c("Baseline", "Post-treatment"))

# Exclude "Other"/"Othres"/"Others" BEFORE computing percentages
timepoint_data4 <- timepoint_data4 %>%
  filter(!tolower(ParentCelltypes) %in% c("other", "others", "othres"))

# Calculate cell type proportions for each timepoint
cell_props4 <- timepoint_data4 %>%
  group_by(BiopsyPhase, ParentCelltypes) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(BiopsyPhase) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (count / sum(count)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Ensure clean interpolation - make sure ALL cell types exist at BOTH timepoints
all_cell_types <- unique(cell_props4$ParentCelltypes)
all_timepoints <- c("Baseline", "Post-treatment")

cell_props_complete <- expand.grid(
  ParentCelltypes = all_cell_types,
  BiopsyPhase = all_timepoints,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(cell_props4, by = c("ParentCelltypes", "BiopsyPhase")) %>%
  mutate(
    count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count),
    percentage = ifelse(is.na(percentage), 0, percentage)
  ) %>%
  # Re-normalize within each timepoint
  group_by(BiopsyPhase) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (percentage / sum(percentage)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Handle any NaN from 0/0
  mutate(percentage = ifelse(is.nan(percentage), 0, percentage))

# Add timepoint numbers
cell_props_expanded4 <- cell_props_complete %>%
  mutate(timepoint_num = ifelse(BiopsyPhase == "Baseline", 1, 3)) %>%
  arrange(ParentCelltypes, timepoint_num)

# Interpolate with enhanced error handling
cell_props_interpolated4 <- cell_props_expanded4 %>%
  group_by(ParentCelltypes) %>%
  reframe(
    timepoint_num = seq(1, 3, by = 0.1),
    percentage = approx(
      x = c(1, 3),
      y = percentage,
      xout = seq(1, 3, by = 0.1),
      method = "linear",
      rule = 2,
      ties = mean
    )$y
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Clean up any NA/NaN
  mutate(percentage = ifelse(is.na(percentage) | is.nan(percentage), 0, percentage)) %>%
  # Re-normalize at each timepoint
  group_by(timepoint_num) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (percentage / sum(percentage)) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Final cleanup
  mutate(percentage = ifelse(is.na(percentage) | is.nan(percentage) | is.infinite(percentage), 0, percentage))

# Define stacking order (bottom to top)
stack_order <- c("Macrophages", "Fibroblasts", "Regulatory T Cells", 
                 "Endothelial Cells", "Effector T Cells", "Cancer Cells")

# Calculate ymin and ymax with safety checks
cell_props_interpolated4 <- cell_props_interpolated4 %>%
  mutate(ParentCelltypes = factor(ParentCelltypes, levels = stack_order)) %>%
  arrange(timepoint_num, ParentCelltypes) %>%
  group_by(timepoint_num) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(percentage),
    ymin = ymax - percentage,
    # Cap ymax at 100
    ymax = pmin(ymax, 100),
    # Ensure ymin is not negative
    ymin = pmax(ymin, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Remove any rows with invalid values
  filter(!is.na(ymin) & !is.na(ymax) & !is.infinite(ymin) & !is.infinite(ymax))

# Define cell type colors
cell_type_colors <- c(
  "Cancer Cells" = "#0000FF",
  "Effector T Cells" = "#00FFFF",
  "Endothelial Cells" = "#4E1251",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#FF0000",
  "Macrophages" = "#00FF00",
  "Regulatory T Cells" = "#FD3DB5"
)

# Plot
p4 <- ggplot(cell_props_interpolated4, aes(x = timepoint_num, fill = ParentCelltypes)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, group = ParentCelltypes), alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 3),
    labels = c("Baseline", "Post-treatment"),
    limits = c(1, 3),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_type_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Patient 017",
    x = "",
    y = "% of Patient 017 cells",
    fill = "Cell Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25))

print(p4)
```
